excerpt.en: Aerial images taken of [From.Planet.GetName]'s rapidly diminishing vegetation could indicate the presence of an unidentified life form habiting its surface.

texts.zh:
我们在[desertling_planet.GetName]上发现了生命。没有智慧的小型哺乳动物群遍布在整个行星表面。

我们的科学家将它们标记为“沙生兽”，它们的数量正以惊人的速度增加。这个行星已经超出了它的承载能力，生态系统正在迅速恶化。
texts.en:
We have found life on [desertling_planet.GetName]. Vast non-sapient herds of small mammals roam across the entire planetary surface.

Their population, labeled 'desertlings' by our scientists, is increasing at an alarming rate. The planet is already beyond its capacity, and the ecosystem is deteriorating rapidly.

label.zh: 调查为什么现在会发生这种情况。
label.en: Investigate why this is happening now.

tooltips.zh: 我们将从远处监控局势。
tooltips.en: We'll monitor the situation from afar.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 一群迅速蔓延的哺乳动物在行星[desertling_planet.Planet.GetName]上过度繁殖。凭借适当的资源，我们的科学家可以收集更多关于这种非智慧物种的起源和能力的线索。
texts.en: The planet [desertling_planet.Planet.GetName] is overpopulated by a herd of rapidly spreading mammals. With the proper resources, our scientists could gather more insights about the origins and capabilities of this non-sapient species.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
在研究[desertling_planet.GetName]上的沙生兽时，我们的科学家观察到了一个关键的现象。尽管这个物种到处都是，但却没有相应的化石记录。这些生态入侵者在相对短的时间内造成了极端的环境破坏，很可能是被某个外来者带到这里的。

形势已经十分清楚，迫切需要我们进行干预。如果不采取行动，这些生物将摧毁这个星球自然生态系统中剩下的一切。
texts.en:
While studying the desertlings on [desertling_planet.GetName] our scientists have made a pivotal observation. Despite the ubiquitous nature of the species, there is a striking absence of matching fossil records. These ecological interlopers have caused extreme environmental damage over a relatively short time period, and were most likely transported here by an outside actor.

The pressing need for intervention has become abundantly clear. Without action, these creatures will destroy what remains of this planet's natural ecosystem.

label.zh: 我们将尽可能多收养这些小东西。
label.en: We will adopt as many critters as possible.

tooltips.zh: 我们将对他们的行为负责。
tooltips.en: We will be responsible for their actions.

label.zh: 制定动物数量控制政策。

tooltips.zh: 选择遗传修饰可用于遏制生长…
tooltips.en: Select genetic modifications could be used to curb the growth...

tooltips.zh: 必须不惜一切代价保护行星。
tooltips.en: The planet must be protected at all cost.

label.zh: 我们将一些动物当作牲口。
label.en: We'll take some animals as livestock.

tooltips.zh: 我们将向每个殖民地带去两个奴隶。
tooltips.en: We'll take two slaves for every colony.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
当我们向这些沙生兽开放我们的殖民地时，没有人能够预料到这样的结果。这些小动物已经完美地适应了我们的生活方式，在我们的领土上，成为了家庭生活中的可爱伴侣。

它们的快速融入引发了一种猜测，即这些生物一定曾经被驯化过。无论是什么原因导致了它们与生俱来的友好，这个传言只增加了人们对这些非凡生物的更进一步兴趣。
texts.en:
When we opened our colonies to the desertlings, no one could have anticipated the results. The critters have adapted seamlessly into our way of life, becoming beloved companions in households all across our territory.

Their rapid integration has led to speculation that these creatures must at once time have been domesticated. Whatever the cause of their innate friendliness, the rumor only adds to the fascination surrounding these extraordinary creatures.

label.zh: 某种程度上，它们拯救了我们。
label.en: In a way, they saved us.

texts.zh: 可怕的消息传来。几只沙生兽在运输过程中逃脱，形成了一个迅速扩大的野生种群。我们必须迅速处理这种情况，以避免环境崩溃。
texts.en: Dire news has reached us. A few desertlings have broken free during transportation, forming a rapidly expanding community in the wild. The situation must be handled swiftly to avoid an environmental collapse.

label.zh: 用围墙建立一个保留地。

texts.zh: 我们在遏制猖獗的沙生兽侵袭方面取得了一定的成功。遗憾的是，我们无法根除这些难以捉摸的野兽。继续监测情况至关重要，因为它可能随时达到临界点。
texts.en: We have been moderately successful in curbing the rampant desertling infestation. Regrettably, we have been unable to eradicate the elusive beasts. It is crucial to continue monitoring the situation, as it could reach a tipping point at any moment.

note.zh: 狩猎后50%：获得资源，侵扰矿藏仍在。
note.en: 50% after the hunt: some resources; the infestation deposit remains.

texts.zh: 我们尝试控制沙生兽，结果是徒劳无功。这些贪婪的生物深挖洞穴，它们扩大它们殖民地的速度比我们消灭它们的速度还要快。除非我们允许我们的军队使用其庞大的爆炸物和有毒气体武器库，否则这场战斗就会失败，并将危及地面上每个人的安危。
texts.en: Our attempt to control the infestation of desertlings has been rendered futile. The voracious creatures have already burrowed deep, expanding their large colonies faster than we can exterminate them. The battle is lost unless we allow our military to use their vast arsenal of explosives and noxious gases, a course of action which would risk the well-being of everyone on the surface.

label.en: The animals are here to stay...

label.zh: 我们可不会输给单纯的啮齿动物。
label.en: We will NOT lose a war to mere rodents.

tooltips.zh: 如果有必要的话，我们会摧毁整个行星。
tooltips.en: We'll destroy the entire planet if we have to.

note.zh: 狩猎后50%：接受外星侵扰修正，或打一场360天的“鼠战”，之后隐藏事件7180移除侵扰矿藏。
note.en: 50% after the hunt: accept an infestation modifier, or wage a 360-day 'rodent war' after which hidden 7180 removes the infestation deposit.

texts.zh: 为了拯救[desertling_planet.GetName]的生态状态，必须抑制入侵动物群的指数级数量增长。我们的科学家需要时间和资源来找到可行的解决方案。
texts.en: To save the ecological state of [desertling_planet.GetName] the exponential population growth of the invading fauna's population must be suppressed. Our scientists need time and resources to find an executable solution.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
经过艰苦的努力，我们对[desertling_planet.GetName]上的沙漠生物进行扑杀和基因改造，它们的数量终于降低到了一个可持续的水平。

没有了过多的食草动物，一个微妙的平衡出现了。大自然正在迅速恢复，新鲜的草地开始在曾经荒凉的沙漠上生长。
texts.en:
After an arduous effort to sterilize and genetically alter the desertlings on [desertling_planet.GetName], their population has finally been reduced to a sustainable level.

Without the overwhelming amount of grazers, a delicate equilibrium has emerged. Nature is rapidly restoring itself, as fresh patches of grass begin to sprout over the once barren desert.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 侵扰解除，行星获丰饶修正与新资源点。
note.en: Infestation removed; Lush Planet and new deposits.

texts.zh: 最终，最后一只啮齿动物在[desertling_planet.GetName]上死去。沙子本身已经被染成了红色，这是因为我们为拯救星球免于侵染所付出的巨大努力，但是新的绿芽已经开始萌发。我们出手的时候刚刚好。
texts.en: Finally, the last of the rodents lie dead on [desertling_planet.GetName]. The sand itself has been tinted red by our massive effort to save the planet from its infestation, but already new green buds have begun to sprout. We were just in time.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们收到消息，[desertling_planet.GetName]已经屈服于指数繁殖的哺乳动物的侵袭。深深的寂静笼罩着现在贫瘠的大地，所有存留的植被都被吞噬到根部。

杂食性的哺乳动物奄奄一息，要么直接饿死，要么在愈演愈烈的饥荒中被同类吃掉。
texts.en:
We have received news that [desertling_planet.GetName], has succumbed to the infestation of the exponentially breeding mammals. Deep silence envelops the now barren landscape, where all traces of vegetation have been devoured down to their roots.

The omnivorous mammals themselves lie still, either perished from starvation, or eaten by their kin as the famine progressed.

label.en: At least the suffering is now over.

summary.text:
# 迅速荒漠化 / Rapid Desertification

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 1级异常，全局仅生成一次；在沙漠或干旱行星上权重1，仅限非机械、非蜂巢帝国；null_spawn_chance 0.7（选中后仍只有30%真正生成）。  
  Level-1 anomaly, once per galaxy; weight 1 on desert or arid planets for non-mechanical, non-hive empires; null_spawn_chance 0.7 (only 30% actually spawn when picked).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 7135：行星被繁殖失控的“沙漠鼠”占据（行星获外星侵扰修正）。调查 → 80天项目“生态系统被蚕食”（限时1080天）；不干预 → 480–510天后 7145 灭绝事件。  
  7135: "desertlings" overrun the planet (alien infestation modifier). Investigate → 80-day project (1,080-day limit); stay out → 7145 extinction after 480–510 days.
- 项目完成 → 7140“入侵物种”；超时失败 → 7146 灭绝事件（行星变为贫瘠，若有殖民地则被摧毁）。  
  Project success → 7140 "Invasive Species"; timeout → 7146 extinction (the planet turns barren, any colony is destroyed).
- 7140 四个选项：收养（非排外；人口超100的星球获“收养外星生物”修正）、人口控制（180天项目 → 7150“自然的新生”：行星获丰饶修正与新资源点）、灭绝（非和平、非亲外；180天后 7155“红色沙漠”）、作为牲畜（允许奴隶制的排外帝国；获得非智慧物种人口）。  
  7140 offers: adopt them (non-xenophobe; colonies over 100 pops get a modifier), population control (180-day project → 7150 "Nature's Rebirth": lush planet and new deposits), extermination (non-pacifist, non-xenophile; 7155 "Red Desert" after 180 days), or livestock (xenophobes allowing slavery; non-sapient pops).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 收养后约3620天：60% colony.7160“国家宝藏”（全国宠物修正，若无失控星球），40% colony.7166“麻烦的小动物”。牲畜选项后3620天：30% colony.7166，70% 无事。  
  After adoption, ~3620 days later: 60% colony.7160 "National Treasures" (if no planet is overrun), 40% colony.7166 "Troublesome Critters". After livestock: 30% colony.7166, 70% nothing.
- colony.7166：猎杀 → 180–240天后 50% colony.7170 稳定（获食物）/ 50% colony.7175 失控；或花能源建围栏保护区（资源点）。7175 可接受（侵扰修正5年）或发动“鼠战”（360天后隐藏事件移除侵扰资源点）。  
  colony.7166: hunt them → after 180–240 days 50% colony.7170 stabilised (food) / 50% colony.7175 out of control; or build a walled reserve. 7175: accept the infestation (5 years) or wage the "rodent war" (a hidden event removes the deposit after 360 days).
- 相关故事：已收养沙漠鼠的帝国此后也可能在殖民地满十年时触发 colony.7165（另一故事，C7），共用7170/7175。  
  Related: empires that adopted desertlings may later get colony.7165 when a colony turns ten (another story, C7), which shares 7170/7175.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 7145/7146 的文本和选项按行星是否有人口区分；无人口时按“重视他者”与否措辞不同。  
  7145/7146 text and options differ by whether the planet is populated; unpopulated wording depends on values_others.
